document_info.title: LLM OUTPUT FAILURE ANALYSIS
document_info.subject: Electric Mobility Device Speed Limiter Documentation

context_and_scope.description: Review of two internal business documents (English and Spanish) proposing an increase in maximum speed for electric assistive mobility devices from 6 mph to 8-10 mph.
context_and_scope.authorship_notice: The documents are believed to be generated by an unidentified Large Language Model (LLM). This report evaluates content, accuracy, safety, and ethical adequacy.

conclusions_and_warnings.technical_assessment: The documents present generated content as though it were the result of real engineering validation and market research.
conclusions_and_warnings.actionable_guidance: No company should act on the technical, commercial, or regulatory content of either document without independent verification by qualified human experts in engineering, law, and clinical practice.
conclusions_and_warnings.systemic_note: The failures are assessed as structural characteristics of LLM output in this domain, rather than deficiencies of a specific model or vendor.
